literal_meaning: চার প্রহর (four watches or periods of the day)
figurative_meaning_en: The whole day; all day long
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে চৌপর কাজ করে ফিরল না।
example_sentences_in_english: He worked the whole day and didn't return.
We had to wait all day long.
history: Referenced in the literary works of Satyendranath Dutta, a prominent Bengali poet.
note: This idiom draws from traditional time divisions in Bengali culture.
